data.one_liner: Telegram-style full-screen image viewer with pinch-to-zoom and swipe gestures.
data.what_it_does: Provides a full-screen image viewer with pinch-to-zoom, swipe-to-navigate gallery mode, thumbnails, and swipe-down-to-dismiss gestures. Supports network URLs, local assets, and device files.
use_when: You need to display images in a full-screen gallery with zoom and swipe gestures
You want a Telegram-style image viewing experience with a single function call
avoid_when: You need inline image widgets inside custom scrolling layouts rather than a full-screen viewer
You need advanced image cropping or editing tools
strengths: Supports network, asset, and local file images
Smooth pinch-to-zoom and swipe gestures out of the box
Customizable UI components like headers, footers, error widgets, and headers for authentication
weaknesses: Local files are not supported on the web platform

alternatives.name: photo_view
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need low-level customizable zoomable widgets instead of a pre-built Telegram-style viewer.
